### [Number of Islands](problems/leetcode/number-of-islands/)

`leetcode:number-of-islands` · Medium

- **Redo:** Need Review: Asked for the solution on 2026-09-20.
- **Key Takeaway:** Scan the grid; each unvisited land cell starts a flood fill that sinks its whole island, so the count of fills is the answer.
- **Approaches:** dfs flood fill (2026-09-20, session, saw-solution); bfs flood fill (2026-10-05, session, solved-with-hints)
- **Past mistakes:**
  - 2026-09-20: Did not mark cells visited, so the recursion looped forever.
  - 2026-10-05: Marked cells visited when popped instead of when pushed, so cells were queued twice.
- **Tags:** array, breadth-first-search, depth-first-search, graph · **Problem Lists:** Grind 75
